To fix the error, modify the line 21 in the file “…\mods\SilverBullet\src\mod.js”.

From

if (this.isMagazine(item._id)) { const cylinderSlots = item._props.Slots.filter((slot) => slot._name.startsWith(“camora”)); if (cylinderSlots.length > 0) { for (const slot of cylinderSlots) { slot._props.filters[0].Filter = availableAmmo; } } item._props.Cartridges[0]._props.filters[0].Filter = availableAmmo; } To

if (this.isMagazine(item._id)) { if (item._props.Slots != null) { const cylinderSlots = item._props.Slots.filter((slot) => slot._name.startsWith(“camora”)); if (cylinderSlots.length > 0) { for (const slot of cylinderSlots) { slot._props.filters[0].Filter = availableAmmo; } } item._props.Cartridges[0]._props.filters[0].Filter = availableAmmo; } }Or just add this condition in line 21 “if (this.isMagazine(item._id) && item._props.Slots != null)”
